gsm.basis: MG tissue as used for papel picado; tissue tariff class 15–30 g/m² (HTS 4805.91), rsE §b

E_md_gpa.basis: rsE §b: specific tensile stiffness × density for MG tissue [E]

E_cd_gpa.basis: MD/CD ≈ 2.2 for machine-made tissue (Baum et al. 1981, rsE §b)

crease_length_scale_t.basis: L* ≈ 200·t measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014); paper unmeasured

provenance.author: Innovaciones MADFAM
sources: Pliego research memo rsE (2026-10-10) §b material default table — engineering estimates [E] unless a source is cited
Baum, Habeger & Fleischman 1981, Measurement of the orthotropic elastic constants of paper — https://bioresources.cnr.ncsu.edu/resources/measurement-of-the-orthotropic-elastic-constants-of-paper/
Lechenault, Thiria & Adda-Bedia 2014, Mechanical response of a creased sheet, PRL 112, 244301 — https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.1243

heritage.makers: Papel picado artisans of San Salvador Huixcolotla

claims.en: Papel picado is considered to originate in San Salvador Huixcolotla, Puebla.
claims.es: Se considera que el papel picado tiene su origen en San Salvador Huixcolotla, Puebla.

claims.en: It is cut from tissue paper (papel de china) with chisels (fierritos) and a mallet through stacks of about 40–50 sheets.
claims.es: Se corta en papel de china con cinceles (fierritos) y mazo, en pilas de unas 40 a 50 hojas.

claims.en: Huixcolotla's papel picado was declared cultural heritage of the State of Puebla in 1998.
claims.es: El papel picado de Huixcolotla fue declarado patrimonio cultural del estado de Puebla en 1998.

claims.en: It adorns Día de Muertos ofrendas, fiestas and weddings.
claims.es: Adorna las ofrendas de Día de Muertos, las fiestas y las bodas.

note.en: The stock is commercial tissue; the heritage credit belongs to the papel picado tradition and its community.
note.es: El material es papel de china comercial; el crédito patrimonial corresponde a la tradición del papel picado y a su comunidad.

caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um estimated: typical machine-glazed tissue, rsE §b

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: MG tissue as used for papel picado; tissue tariff class 15–30 g/m² (HTS 4805.91), rsE §b

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: rsE §b: specific tensile stiffness × density for MG tissue [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: typical machine-glazed tissue, rsE §b

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: MD/CD ≈ 2.2 for machine-made tissue (Baum et al. 1981, rsE §b); physical.caliper_um estimated: typical machine-glazed tissue, rsE §b

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981)

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: rsE §b: specific tensile stiffness × density for MG tissue [E]; physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); physical.caliper_um estimated: typical machine-glazed tissue, rsE §b

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: MD/CD ≈ 2.2 for machine-made tissue (Baum et al. 1981, rsE §b); physical.nu estimated: √(ν12·ν21) = 0.293 for machine-made paper (Baum et al. 1981); physical.caliper_um estimated: typical machine-glazed tissue, rsE §b

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: L* ≈ 200·t measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014); paper unmeasured

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: rest opening 27–43° after creasing (Lechenault 2014)

crease_set_rate.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.crease_set_rate)

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
